description: This file implements the main interactive component for a Tic Tac Toe game using React. It includes functions for calculating the winner, formatting move labels, and the core React component handling game state, rendering the game board, move history, and game controls.

methods.name: calculateWinner
methods.description: Determines if there is a winner in the current Tic Tac Toe board state, returning the winner and winning line if any.

methods.name: formatMoveLabel
methods.description: Creates a label for move history display, indicating move number and optionally row and column.
